findings.reason: Launcher used PSHOME\\powershell.exe, which does not exist in this runtime

findings.observed_error: Windows PowerShell child could not resolve Get-FileHash while writing its error receipt; receipt absent
Windows PowerShell child could not resolve Get-FileHash in preflight and again in error handling

root_cause: Native PS 5.1 child inherits a module environment where Get-FileHash is not discoverable; standard utility module files exist, but the cmdlet is absent in the hidden child. This is a launcher-runtime dependency issue, not a DOCX or Word rendering failure.
repair: Use a local .NET SHA256 helper in the exporter and retain explicit native process ownership checks.
